glossary.definition: (1) "Abused child" has the same meaning as in section 2151.031 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 149.435 - Confidentiality of records regarding abused children.

glossary.definition: (2) "Confidential law enforcement investigatory record" has the same meaning as in section 149.43 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 149.435 - Confidentiality of records regarding abused children.

glossary.definition: (3) "Law enforcement agency" means a municipal or township police department, the office of a sheriff, the state highway patrol, federal law enforcement, a county prosecuting attorney, the office of the United States attorney, or a state or local governmental body that enforces criminal laws and that has employees who have a statutory power of arrest.
glossary.source_title: Section 149.435 - Confidentiality of records regarding abused children.

glossary.definition: (4) "Prosecutor" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 149.435 - Confidentiality of records regarding abused children.
